containerDefinitions.name: ivs-broadcaster
command:
apk add --no-cache ffmpeg ca-certificates python3 >/dev/null && update-ca-certificates >/dev/null && python3 - <<'PY'
import os,signal,subprocess,sys,threading
key=os.environ["IVS_STREAM_KEY"]
endpoint=os.environ["IVS_INGEST_ENDPOINT"]
source=os.environ["SOURCE_VIDEO"]
args=["ffmpeg","-hide_banner","-loglevel","error","-nostdin","-stream_loop","-1","-re","-i",source,"-map","0:v:0","-map","0:a?","-c:v","libx264","-preset","veryfast","-tune","zerolatency","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-r","30","-g","60","-b:v","2200k","-maxrate","2200k","-bufsize","4400k","-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k","-ar","44100","-tls_verify","1","-ca_file","/etc/ssl/cert.pem","-f","flv",f"rtmps://{endpoint}/app/{key}"]
proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,bufsize=1)
auto_stop=threading.Event()
def stop(*_):
 if proc.poll() is None: proc.terminate()
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,stop)
timer=threading.Timer(3600,lambda:(auto_stop.set(),stop()))
timer.start()
for line in proc.stderr:
 sys.stderr.write(line.replace(key,"[redacted]")); sys.stderr.flush()
code=proc.wait()
timer.cancel()
sys.exit(0 if auto_stop.is_set() or code in (0,-signal.SIGTERM) else code)
PY
